records.detail: Amundi Asset Management is one of three outside firms the Banco Central de Bolivia hires to invest the Fondo RAL-ME, the foreign-currency reserve requirement that Bolivian banks must hold at the central bank. The central bank says it manages this fund the same way it manages the international reserves. The fund held USD 1,052 million on 31 December 2018. The report also records two breaches by Amundi in 2018: on 23 January and 22 October it traded through Wells Fargo Securities International Limited, a broker not approved for the fund, and on 30 November it went over the 5 percent limit on exposure to a single bank, a position sold on 3 December 2018.
records.source_title: Banco Central de Bolivia, Informe de Administracion de las Reservas Internacionales 2018, Anexo 4, seccion 2 'Fondo RAL-ME'
records.quote: El Fondo RAL-ME esta constituido por el encaje legal en moneda extranjera de las entidades financieras del pais, cuyas inversiones las realizan administradores delegados contratados por el BCB, los encargados de administrar este Fondo son los delegados Amundi Asset Management (Francia), BlackRock Financial Management, Inc. (EE.UU.) y UBS Asset Management (Americas) Inc. (EE.UU.).

records.detail: BlackRock Financial Management, Inc. is one of three outside firms the Banco Central de Bolivia hires to invest the Fondo RAL-ME, the foreign-currency reserve requirement that Bolivian banks must hold at the central bank, a fund the bank says it runs on the same lines as the international reserves. The fund held USD 1,052 million on 31 December 2018, down USD 382 million over the year after the board cut foreign-currency reserve requirement rates in April 2018. Over 2018 BlackRock kept a steady share of its holdings in bank, supranational and corporate paper, with investments concentrated in shorter maturities.

records.name_as_stated: the World Bank Treasury under a special program known as Reserve Advisory Management Program (RAMP)
records.detail: The Bank of Tanzania's note on foreign currency marketable securities says part of that holding is managed in-house and part is managed from outside by the World Bank Treasury under its Reserve Advisory and Management Program. Most of the securities are government bonds rated at least AA, paying fixed interest with set maturity dates. The whole note came to TZS 6,255.0 billion on 30 June 2021, of which the internally managed portfolio measured at fair value through other comprehensive income was TZS 5,540.7 billion and the securities designated at fair value through profit or loss, which the accounting policy note describes as the externally managed ones, were TZS 690.5 billion.
records.source_title: Bank of Tanzania Annual Report 2020/21, Notes to the Financial Statements, Note 20 'Foreign Currency Marketable Securities' (and Note 3, Financial assets designated as measured at FVTPL)
records.quote: These are financial assets consisting of foreign currency marketable securities that are internally managed, and portfolio externally managed by the World Bank Treasury under a special program known as Reserve Advisory Management Program (RAMP).

records.detail: Crown Agents Investment Management runs an externally managed portfolio of the Central Bank of Seychelles' international reserves, split into a US dollar part and a Chinese yuan part. At the end of 2025 the dollar part held US$26.8 million and the yuan part held CNY190 million, up 3.16 percent from CNY184 million at the end of 2024, with a cumulative return of 17.4 percent since the yuan part started in 2022. The dollar part has run against an ICE BofA benchmark since 2014.

records.people: Somphao Phaysith (spelled Somphao Phaisith by the bank)
records.move: President of the Management Board of Joint Development Bank (2007-2009), then Governor of the Bank of the Lao PDR (2009-2018)
records.summary: Joint Development Bank's own history page lists 'Mr. Somphao Phaisith (2007-2009)' as president of its Management Board. The same page says the bank opened on 3 October 1989 as a joint venture in which 'Thai investors represented by Phongsouvan Sailo and Opphuad held 70% of the Bank's shares, while the Lao side, represented by the Bank of the Lao PDR, held the remaining 30%', and that after the 2012 share transfer to Simoung Group JDB became 'a 100% Lao-owned private commercial bank'. So during Somphao Phaisith's 2007-2009 term the bank's shares were 70% in the hands of named Thai investors and 30% with the central bank. Wikipedia's list of heads of the Lao central bank gives Somphao Phaysith as governor from 2009 to 2018, immediately after the JDB term.
records.source_title: Joint Development Bank - About (Public in Brief; list of Presidents of the Management Board)
records.ownership_quote: Thai investors represented by Phongsouvan Sailo and Opphuad held 70% of the Bank's shares, while the Lao side, represented by the Bank of the Lao PDR, held the remaining 30%. ... On 15 June 2010, the Bank of the Lao PDR transferred all of its shares to the Thai investor Mr. Silod Singsomboun ... resulting in JDB becoming a 100% Lao-owned private commercial bank.
